title: Gender Bias Mitigation for Bangla Classification Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: Counterfactual data substitution via gender-name swapping techniques. The authors swap masculine and feminine names and gender-specific terms in task-specific Bangla datasets (sentiment analysis, toxicity detection, hate speech detection, and sarcasm detection) and measure bias by calculating the percentage of mismatched predictions between the original and the gender-swapped texts.
